name: Invention Focus
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tinkerer Class, any two Tinkerer feats, character level 8th or higher

Benefit(s): Choose one type of invention (Offensive, Defensive, or Utility). When creating an invention of the chosen type, you can add 1 to the DC of any saving throws required by that invention.
